mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.product_id AS productId, p.title AS productTitle, t.buyer_id AS buyerId, bu.nickname AS buyerNickname, bu.avatar AS buyerAvatar, t.seller_id AS sellerId, su.nickname AS sellerNickname, su.avatar AS sellerAvatar, t.price, t.status, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime FROM secondhand_transaction t INNER JOIN secondhand_product p ON t.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sys_user bu ON t.buyer_id = bu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON t.seller_id = su.id WHERE t.buyer_id = #{userId} OR t.seller_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
